extract_gold_passage_ids: extract the document ID from a gold answer list containing a string and an integer
normalize_passage_id: normalize a passage ID by converting it to a stripped string
normalize_answer: normalize an answer string by lowercasing, removing punctuation, articles, and fixing whitespace
compute_em: compute exact match score between gold answers and a predicted answer
compute_f1: compute F1 score between gold answers and a predicted answer using token overlap
